fusions.name: Crushing Embrace
fusions.desc: Seizes the target in both arms. It deals 13 damage, stuns the target for 1.4 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Deadfall
fusions.desc: Drops your full weight on the ground around you. It deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, and every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Rear to Full Height
fusions.desc: Increases your maximum health by 25% for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Winter Fat
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
